about: Test vectors for the rescue code (net/pairing.py, docs/SYNC-PLAN.md §2). Bytes as hex unless noted. code = 24 characters + check character Alphabet[(sum of (i+1)*index) mod 31]; key of both BLAKE2b = the 25 normalised characters as ASCII; data = base64(nonce + secretbox(JSON sorted, no spaces)).

sign.put: rescue_put|<address>|<rid>|<sha256 hex of the data string (its base64 text as ASCII, as /v1/send)>|<t>
